failure.step: Verify governed goal model protocol and recovery
failure.error: callback is not a function; subsequent tests cancelled with pending Promise
failure.cause: The initial unbranded-manager rejection test loaded llm-manager before the fixture installed inactive-provider and Axios guards. A complete CI dependency installation cached the unguarded manager, so its /models health check entered the three-argument model transport mock. Missing local optional dependencies had masked the module-load error behind a broad assert.throws.

fix: Initialize the real fixture manager under its inactive-provider and Axios guards before tests can cache it.
Require the exact unbranded-manager rejection code, rather than accepting an unrelated module-loading error.
Count every mock request before argument/body validation, and assert the model adapter callback signature.
Add a regression proving initialization, health checks and denied consent do not enter model transport.
